This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
Start your day with these 7 simple morning yoga stretches that can be done right on your bed. This flow helps awaken the body, ease morning stiffness, and bring a sense of lightness and energy without rushing.
You can practice this flow soon after waking up or anytime during the day when your body needs a gentle reset and some care.
Wishing you an uplifting start to your morning and a productive day ahead!
